purpose: Preserve DEFINED vs UNDEFINED vs completely OPEN semantics without converting R2 openCenters into a false three-state classification.

DEFINED.definition: Center state explicitly confirmed as defined in external chart intake.
DEFINED.gateRequirement: No independent W7 gate rule; definition remains confirmed external structure.
DEFINED.channelConflict: A confirmed complete channel can support but must not be used by W7 to silently recalculate the external chart.

UNDEFINED.definition: Center explicitly confirmed as non-defined while one or more gate activations in that center are confirmed.
UNDEFINED.channelConflict: A confirmed complete channel defining the center conflicts with UNDEFINED and requires reconfirmation.

OPEN.definition: Center explicitly confirmed as non-defined with no confirmed gate activation in that center.
OPEN.channelConflict: Any confirmed gate or complete defining channel conflicts with OPEN and requires reconfirmation.
